subject: SET statement
notes: FORMAT 14 — "This statement shall not be executed during the execution of a SEARCH statement referring to the same table. If this rule is violated, the EC-FLOW-SEARCH exception condition is set to exist and the SET statement is not executed" (cite.py --check 14.9.39.4 PASS). Both consequents are implemented, and the guard is keyed on THE TABLE (a per-CobolDynTable counter), not on "a search is running", which is exactly the discrimination the rule's "referring to the same table" demands. Three edges measured beyond the existing golden. (1) SAME table, SEARCH ALL rather than serial — probe p4_gr31_all, `SEARCH ALL E … SET CAP TO 6` under `>>TURN EC-FLOW-SEARCH CHECKING ON`, terminates with `EC-FLOW-SEARCH (fatal): SET of a dynamic-capacity table's capacity during a SEARCH of that same table (ISO §14.9.39.4 GR31)`; both SEARCH forms share EmitSearch, so one bracket covers both. (2) DIFFERENT table — probe p4_gr31_other, two dynamic tables, `SEARCH E1 … SET C2 TO 6`, runs clean and C2 becomes 6, so the rule does NOT over-fire. (3) The checking-OFF disposition — conformance:cases/14.9.39-SET/ec_flow_search_set_capacity (registered in tests/conformance/2023/manifest.json) drives the fatal declarative + RESUME AT NEXT STATEMENT path and asserts CAP-UNCHANGED, the value GR31's second sentence computes; it is spec-derived (its header quotes GR31 and derives the expectation from it, not from an oracle), so it closes this row. The try/finally means a SET reached from anywhere inside the scan — a PERFORMed paragraph, a declarative — is still guarded, and the `_searching` counter is nestable for a re-entrant SEARCH.  || CODE SITES (verbatim from the adjudication, kept because the schema's code-location is symbol-keyed, not line-keyed): src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/Values/Tables/CobolDynTable.cs:115-127 (SetCapacity's `if (_searching > 0) { ExceptionState.FlowSearchError(…); return; }` — GR31's own "and the SET statement is not executed") + CobolDynTable.cs:170-175 (EnterSearch/ExitSearch, nestable) + src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/CodeGen/Verbs/ControlFlowEmitter.cs:379-392 (EmitSearch wraps the scan in try/finally so ExitSearch runs on every `goto __searchEnd` exit path)
